subject: Literature

questions.text: This paper consists of sections A, B and C with a total of ten (10) questions.
Cellular phones and any unauthorised materials are not allowed in the examination room.
Write your Examination Number on every page of your answer booklet(s).

Hyena and Leopard were best friends, their friendship ended when Leopard realised that his friend was mean, jealous and a coward when hunting. In life, it is better to have a friend whom you share the same attitude with. This story may be classified as a myth legend proverb idiom fable Choose Answer : - -
What term refers to a word that occurs more than once in a verse? Refrain Repetition Parallelism Ellipsis Contrast Choose Answer : - -
Which literary term is given to the major divisions of a play? Act Movement Narration Chapter Scene Choose Answer : - -
How is the plot of the play, 'The Lion and the Jewel' arranged? Act and pages Act and setting Act and scenes Act and sections Act and chapter Choose Answer : - -

When composing a poem, one deliberately breaks some aspects of grammar to suit poetic purposes. How is this freedom called? Assonance Poetic language Consonance Poetic license Meter Choose Answer : - -

Suppose you have been asked to write a story with the main character that bears heroic elements. How is this character identified? An Antagonist A Dynamic A Round A Static A Protagonist Choose Answer : - -
A verse in a stanza reads, "sing a song, God is good' The quoted verse is an example Of refrain alliteration dissonant assonance parallelism Choose Answer : - -
Which element of plot in the of art can you substitute with 'Yesolution"? Denouement Climax Exposition Rising Oratory Choose Answer : - -

Which point of view is to be considered when writing narratives? First person point of view Character point of view Omniscient point of view Second person point of view Narrator point of view Choose Answer : - -

Which one is the advantage of science and technology to oral literature? Improve unity among the people Easy to access It is expensive Increase the participation of people Makes all people equal Choose Answer : - -

Match the descriptions of narratives in List A with the type of narratives in List B by writing the letter of the correct response beside the corresponding item number in the answer booklet(s) provided. List A List B
A narrative style that interrupts the chronological order of events.
A narrative that reveals the achievement of the hero.
A narrative in which one writes about his or her own life history.
A narrative in which one tells the history of another person.
A narrative about the creation of the world and super natural forces. Autobiography Myth Flashback Legend Biography Fork tell Foreshadowing View Ans

Justify each of the following functions of literature by giving one example from the play the " Lion and the Jewel " by Soyinka, W. (a) Literature criticises the society. View Ans (b) Literature entertains the society. View Ans (c) Literature educates the society. View Ans (d) Literature warns the society. View Ans (e) Literature reflects the culture. View Ans

Read the following poem and then answer the questions that follow. A Baby is a European - By Ewe (Togo) A baby is a European He does not eat our food He drinks from his own water pot. A baby is a European He does not speak our tongue He crosses when the mother understands him not. A baby is a European He cares very little for others He forces his will upon his parents. Questions: (a) Briefly explain what the poem is about? View Ans (b) Briefly explain two literary devices found in the poem. View Ans (c) Which language does the baby speak? Give a reason for your answer. View Ans (d) How does the baby treat his own father and mother? View Ans (e) Is the poem relevant to our society? Give a reason for your answer. View Ans

Write the correct answer for each of the item (a)-(e) in the answer booklet provided (a) How is the plot arranged in a play? (b) When a playwright uses mime as one of the devices of literature, how are his or her characters expected to behave in the literary work? (c) Why is aesthetic important in a work of art? Briefly explain. (d) How can the poet apply metaphor in a verse? (e) What is the major function of a setting in a literary work? View Ans

Write short answers for each of the item (a) - (e) in the answer booklet provided. (a) Why is foreshadowing used in drama or novels? (b) Why is the resolution important in the development of plot of a literary work? Briefly explain. (c) How is the dynamic character developed? (d) Using the concept of characterisation, briefly explain the statement that; "the novelist is a creator" (e) How can one use irony to convey message? Briefly explain. View Ans

"Literature does not exist in a vacuum, it lives and talks about what is happening in the society." Defend this contention by referring to two plays; Dilemma of the Ghost by Christina Ama Ata Aidoo and The Trials of Brother Jero by Wole Soyinka . Give three points for each play. View Ans
It is argued that, poems are rich in the use of figures of speech. Support this argument with reference to two poems. Give three points for each poem. View Ans
Some characters are not accepted in their society. Justify this statement using two novels read. Give three points for each novel. View Ans
With reference to any two novels read, examine the social challenges which face characters in their daily life. Write three points from each novel. View Ans
